_doc: Label definition for external DFL data (docs/label_semantics.md). Raw BallPossession flips on every touch. Models train on min_control(min_control_tau_s): sub-half-second flicker removed, physical ball ownership kept. The granularity of 'controlled possession' is a decoder parameter, tuned for robustness over the label views in eval_taus_s. Nothing here is fitted to the target ground truth.
